lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense constellation of high-luminance, roughly circular blobs arranged in a staggered, semi-regular grid pattern across the mid-to-posterior lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of increased pixel intensity that align with the vertical columns of blobs, creating a grid-like intersection pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal feature on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp luminance transition, separating the dorsal and lateral regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent dark, vertical linear marking on the mid-flank area, consistent with a healed scar.
